texte:
Thank you, @fabrika_festival, for a great time last weekend. It was such an honor to close the festival.
I don’t like to fly in and out when I play. If I decide to come, I want to experience the whole festival: as a guest, colleague, artist and friend. Fabrika was great from the very first second: the warm welcome, the conversations, the inspiration, discovering new artists, meeting new and old friends.
Then came the closing, when the festival was already officially over. I was supposed to play in the dark and finish at sunrise, but I said: don’t stop @foehn_and_jerome , they’re on fire! So I started 3.5 hours after my official set time. When my set ended, the dancefloor was still burning, so I kept going.
Then came the closing of the closing: I only needed a MIDI cable from @ion_ludwig, and he showed up with his whole setup. The rest is history. We played another 6-hour live set.

None of this would have been possible without the whole Fabrika team, from the organizers to the cleaners. What a team!
Special thanks to the organizers and @solid____ for the invitation and the trust.
It was my first time there, and I hope not the last.
Thank you all. Barcha barcha merci ❤️❤️❤️

And just like that, the final chapter.
We closed it together at Stage 1, tired, happy and not ready to leave.

The sun came back, everything was back in place, and so were you.
One more day together.
Wet, loud, packed and beautiful. Then a sunny morning.

Tunisia gave us the sea and the sun. Fabrika gave us the records and the dancefloor.
You gave us everything else.
